heading.en: When a couple cannot have a child

hook.en: Many couples cannot conceive even after two years of unprotected cohabitation. Science now offers them several ways to have a child.
hook.kn: ಎರಡು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಂತರವೂ ಅನೇಕ ದಂಪತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಈಗ ಅನೇಕ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Many couples cannot conceive even after two years of unprotected cohabitation. Science now offers them several ways to have a child.
narration.kn: ಎರಡು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಂತರವೂ ಅನೇಕ ದಂಪತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಈಗ ಅನೇಕ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Infertility may be physical, congenital, due to diseases, drugs, immunological or even psychological, and the problem may be in the male or the female. In in-vitro fertilisation followed by embryo transfer (IVF–ET, the 'test tube baby' programme), ova from the wife or a donor and sperm from the husband or a donor are fused in the laboratory. In ZIFT the zygote or early embryo with up to 8 blastomeres is transferred into the fallopian tube; in IUT an embryo with more than 8 blastomeres is transferred into the uterus.
body.kn: ಬಂಜೆತನಕ್ಕೆ ದೈಹಿಕ, ಜನ್ಮಜಾತ, ರೋಗ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಕಾರಣಗಳಿರಬಹುದು. IVF–ETಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಷೇಚನ ಮಾಡಿ ಭ್ರೂಣವನ್ನು ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ZIFTನಲ್ಲಿ 8 ಕೋಶಗಳವರೆಗಿನ ಭ್ರೂಣ ಅಂಡನಾಳಕ್ಕೆ, IUTನಲ್ಲಿ 8ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೋಶಗಳ ಭ್ರೂಣ ಗರ್ಭಾಶಯಕ್ಕೆ.

points.en: ZIFT: up to 8 blastomeres → fallopian tube

narration.en: Infertility may be physical, congenital, due to diseases, drugs, immunological or even psychological, and the problem may be in the male or the female. In in-vitro fertilisation followed by embryo transfer (IVF–ET, the 'test tube baby' programme), ova from the wife or a donor and sperm from the husband or a donor are fused in the laboratory. In ZIFT the zygote or early embryo with up to 8 blastomeres is transferred into the fallopian tube; in IUT an embryo with more than 8 blastomeres is transferred into the uterus.
narration.kn: ಬಂಜೆತನಕ್ಕೆ ದೈಹಿಕ, ಜನ್ಮಜಾತ, ರೋಗ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಕಾರಣಗಳಿರಬಹುದು. IVF–ETಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಷೇಚನ ಮಾಡಿ ಭ್ರೂಣವನ್ನು ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ZIFTನಲ್ಲಿ 8 ಕೋಶಗಳವರೆಗಿನ ಭ್ರೂಣ ಅಂಡನಾಳಕ್ಕೆ, IUTನಲ್ಲಿ 8ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೋಶಗಳ ಭ್ರೂಣ ಗರ್ಭಾಶಯಕ್ಕೆ.

body.en: In GIFT, an ovum collected from a donor is transferred into the fallopian tube of a female who cannot produce ova but can provide a suitable environment for fertilisation. In ICSI a sperm is injected directly into the ovum in the laboratory. When the male cannot inseminate or has a very low sperm count, artificial insemination (AI) introduces his or a donor's semen into the vagina or uterus (IUI, intra-uterine insemination). These methods need specialised, costly centres; adoption is another option.
body.kn: GIFTನಲ್ಲಿ ದಾನಿಯ ಅಂಡಾಣುವನ್ನು ಅಂಡನಾಳಕ್ಕೆ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ICSIನಲ್ಲಿ ವೀರ್ಯಾಣುವನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಅಂಡಾಣುವಿಗೆ ಚುಚ್ಚಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ವೀರ್ಯಾಣು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಕೃತಕ ವೀರ್ಯಸೇಚನ (AI/IUI).

points.en: AI / IUI: for low sperm count

problem.en: Choose the ART for each case: (a) a woman cannot produce ova but her oviducts are normal; (b) a man has a very low sperm count; (c) an embryo with 16 blastomeres is ready for transfer.

steps.en: (a) An ovum from a donor is placed in her fallopian tube: GIFT.
(b) His semen is collected and introduced into the uterus: artificial insemination (IUI); ICSI is another option.
(c) An embryo with more than 8 blastomeres goes into the uterus: IUT.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Choose the ART for each case: (a) a woman cannot produce ova but her oviducts are normal; (b) a man has a very low sperm count; (c) an embryo with 16 blastomeres is ready for transfer.

body.en: Count to eight. Eight or fewer blastomeres go to the Fallopian tube (ZIFT: F for Fallopian); more than eight go to the Uterus (IUT: U for Uterus).

narration.en: A quick memory trick. Count to eight. Eight or fewer blastomeres go to the Fallopian tube (ZIFT: F for Fallopian); more than eight go to the Uterus (IUT: U for Uterus).
Roll-call quiz. When your roll number is called, give your own answer.
narration.kn: ಹಾಜರಾತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕ್ರಮಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮದೇ ಉತ್ತರ ಹೇಳಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the NEET and KCET pattern. Read every option before you choose.

points.en: IVF–ET is the test-tube baby programme.
ZIFT ≤ 8 blastomeres into oviduct; IUT > 8 into uterus.
GIFT transfers a donor ovum; ICSI injects a sperm into the ovum.
points.kn: GIFT ದಾನಿ ಅಂಡಾಣು; ICSI ವೀರ್ಯಾಣುವನ್ನು ಅಂಡಾಣುವಿಗೆ ಚುಚ್ಚುವುದು.

points.en: AI / IUI helps when the sperm count is low.

homework.en: Expand: IVF, ZIFT, IUT, GIFT, ICSI, IUI.

narration.en: Recap. IVF–ET is the test-tube baby programme. ZIFT ≤ 8 blastomeres into oviduct; IUT > 8 into uterus. GIFT transfers a donor ovum; ICSI injects a sperm into the ovum. AI / IUI helps when the sperm count is low.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. IVF–ET ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾನಳಿಕೆ ಶಿಶು ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮ. ZIFT ≤ 8 ಕೋಶಗಳು ಅಂಡನಾಳಕ್ಕೆ; IUT > 8 ಗರ್ಭಾಶಯಕ್ಕೆ. GIFT ದಾನಿ ಅಂಡಾಣು; ICSI ವೀರ್ಯಾಣುವನ್ನು ಅಂಡಾಣುವಿಗೆ ಚುಚ್ಚುವುದು. ವೀರ್ಯಾಣು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇದ್ದಾಗ AI/IUI.
